### POST /api/v1/equipment/

| Field | Contract |
|---|---|
| Endpoint ID | `equipment_create` |
| Method and path | `POST /api/v1/equipment/` |
| Business purpose | Add (equipment). |

| Request schema | `EquipmentCreateRequest`: `department` (uuid), `ward` (uuid), `room` (uuid), `location_note` (≤ 120 characters), `category` (one of the listed values), `manufacturer` (≤ 120 characters), `model_name` (≤ 120 characters), `serial_number` (≤ 80 characters), `purchased_on` (date), `warranty_until` (date), `last_service_on` (date), `next_service_due` (date), `last_calibrated_on` (date), `next_calibration_due` (date), `notes` (≤ 1000 characters), `facility` (required, uuid), `asset_tag` (required, ≤ 40 characters), `name` (required, ≤ 120 characters) |
| Response schema | 201 `Equipment` |
| Validation rules | Fields as in the request schema; anything invalid is 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` with each field's problem, and nothing is saved |
| Allowed current states | Any (no state rule) |
| Resulting state | As in the purpose above; the new state is in the response and the audit event |
| Idempotency key behavior | `Idempotency-Key` header (optional; operation `equipment.create`): the same key with the same body replays the stored answer (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`); with a different body 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; kept 48 hours |
| Concurrency control | No version check (adds a new record or is a one-off action); unique rules in the database refuse duplicates |
| Database transaction | One transaction: the change, its audit event and any background event are saved together or not at all |
| Audit event | `equipment.created` |
| Outbox / domain event | None |
| External calls | None |
| Timeout and retry policy | No outside calls inside the request; the client may retry a lost answer with the same Idempotency-Key |
| Expected error codes | 400 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED`, 400 `INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY`, 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`, 401 `NOT_AUTHENTICATED`, 403 `MFA_SETUP_REQUIRED`, 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`, 409 `CONFLICT`, 409 `FEATURE_DISABLED`, 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`, 429 `RATE_LIMITED`, 503 `DEPLOYMENT_NOT_PROVISIONED` |
| Rate / volume assumptions | not signed in: 60/min per address (`HIMS_THROTTLE_ANON`); signed in: 1200/min per address (`HIMS_THROTTLE_USER`) |
| Metrics and alerts | Request log line and trace span with `request_id`, status and time; response-time targets checked by the volume check (HIMS-OPS-017); hosted alarms with HIMS-OPS-004 |
| Automated test cases | `apps/equipment/tests/test_equipment.py::test_due_state_and_its_list_filter_agree`, `apps/equipment/tests/test_equipment.py::test_lists_filter_by_status_category_and_search` |
